A '''tornado''' is a non-interactive NPC that spawns during the final encounter of [[The Gauntlet]].

When [[Crystalline Hunllef]] is above 66% health one tornado is spawned, between 33% - 66% health two tornadoes are spawned, and below 33% health three tornadoes are spawned. The tornadoes will follow the player around the room. Twenty ticks (12.0 seconds) after spawning the tornadoes will despawn. 

Tornadoes will damage the player every tick they are on the same tile depending on the tier of armour the player is wearing.
